title: BTS Sweeps 52nd American Music Awards — Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer & Best Male K-Pop Artist
detail: BTS sweeps all three of their nominations at the 52nd American Music Awards held on May 25, 2026 (Memorial Day) at MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, hosted by Queen Latifah and broadcast live on CBS. They win Artist of the Year (their second win in that category, defeating Bad Bunny, Bruno Mars, Taylor Swift, and Lady Gaga), Song of the Summer for 'SWIM', and Best Male K-Pop Artist. BTS also opened the ceremony performing 'Hooligan' and presented SZA with the Best Female R&B Artist award. The triple-sweep brings their total AMA win count to 14, extending their record as the most decorated act in AMA history. This is BTS's first US televised awards ceremony as a full group in approximately four years, converging with their sold-out ARIRANG World Tour residency at Allegiant Stadium — also in Las Vegas. The Hollywood Reporter and Billboard described the evening as a defining moment in BTS's global comeback, with social media reaction breaking platform records in South Korea, the Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, Brazil, and the United States.

media.caption: BTS sweeps the 52nd American Music Awards — Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer, and Best Male K-Pop Artist — at MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas, May 25, 2026

title: 'SWIM' Surpasses 500 Million Spotify Streams — First 2026 Release Globally to Reach Milestone
detail: BTS's comeback single 'SWIM' surpasses 500 million Spotify streams on May 26, 2026 — confirmed by Big Hit Music — becoming the first song released anywhere in the world in 2026 to reach that milestone. The achievement follows BTS's triple-sweep at the 52nd AMAs the previous evening. Korea Times and Korea Herald both reported the milestone, with Starnews Korea noting the timing as symbolically significant given the convergence of the AMA wins and the ongoing Las Vegas ARIRANG World Tour residency. Additionally, 'Hooligan' (performed as the AMAs opening number on May 25) crossed 200 million Spotify streams on May 26. All 14 tracks on the ARIRANG album have now individually surpassed 100 million Spotify streams. SWIM continues its run on the Billboard Hot 100 (ninth consecutive charting week) and maintains its Global 200 top-5 position.

media.caption: BTS 'SWIM' becomes the first 2026 release globally to surpass 500 million Spotify streams — May 26, 2026

title: BTS × Oreo Limited Edition Hotteok-Flavored Collaboration Announced
detail: Nabisco and HYBE announce a limited-edition BTS × Oreo collaboration: purple-wafer hotteok-flavored Oreo cookies, each wafer engraved with one of the seven BTS members' names and BTS light stick designs, going on sale June 1, 2026 in over 80 countries. The collaboration is positioned around BTS's full-group comeback and the ARIRANG World Tour. CNN Business reported the deal is Oreo's first K-pop branded partnership since its 2023 collaboration with BLACKPINK. Pre-registration for notification of the sale opened May 26. The hotteok flavor — a traditional Korean sweet filled pancake — marks an intentional Korean cultural element in the partnership, continuing BTS's long-standing pattern of Hallyu wave cultural export through commercial collaborations.

media.caption: BTS × Oreo limited edition hotteok-flavored collaboration announced, going on sale June 1, 2026 in 80+ countries
